title: The Billy goat and wagon
summary: He works in a packing house and gets a Billy goat his father harnesses to a wagon.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: stamping meat. I worked there for, oh, maybe a year. Then I once saw a Billy goat and I wanted my father to get me a Billy goat, but he didn't want me to have a goat, he wanted me to have a pony. So while he was working for the Nashville Saddlery Company, he made a set of harness for a pony; but I never got the pony; but I saw a goat, so I got a Billy goat and he made a harness to fit the Billy goat and I made myself a wagon and they let me put the goat in the shed, the coal shed. That's where I kept the goat with the wagon and all.
Anyway, that went on for about three years.
Did it have a special meaning to you, the Billy goat?

Oh, I wanted a goat because the goat was popular. I had friends that had goats, you know, and I got a goat. Then I wanted to do the last day of school performances of the show they have on, I wanted my father to make me a carrier-van and have a Billy goat and do Indian and cowboy stories, which I put on at the school, you know. And that was my popularity and I wanted to have that movement
